questions.question_text: Match the word with its meaning: collect
questions.correct_answer: To bring or gather things as a hobby
questions.explanation: Collect means to gather and keep things that you are interested in.

questions.question_text: Match the word with its meaning: bird-watching
questions.correct_answer: The activity of watching birds in nature
questions.explanation: Bird-watching is a hobby in which people observe birds.

questions.question_text: Match the word with its meaning: board game
questions.correct_answer: A game played on a flat board
questions.explanation: Board games are played using a board, pieces or cards.

questions.question_text: Match the word with its meaning: carve
questions.correct_answer: To make something by cutting wood or another material
questions.explanation: Carve means to shape an object by cutting its surface.

questions.question_text: Match the word with its meaning: cardboard
questions.correct_answer: Thick, stiff paper used for making boxes
questions.explanation: Cardboard is a strong type of paper often used for packaging.

questions.question_text: Match the word with its meaning: dollhouse
questions.correct_answer: A small toy house for dolls
questions.explanation: A dollhouse is a miniature house used as a toy.

questions.question_text: Match the word with its meaning: creativity
questions.correct_answer: The ability to produce new and original ideas
questions.explanation: Creativity is the ability to think of and create new things.

questions.question_text: Match the phrase with its meaning: belong to
questions.explanation: Belong to means to be someone's property.

questions.question_text: I have many stamps in my collection. I love to ______ them.
questions.explanation: Collect means to gather and keep things as a hobby.

questions.question_text: My father enjoys ______ in the park to see different kinds of birds.
questions.explanation: Bird-watching is the activity of observing birds.

questions.question_text: We often play a ______ game with our family at weekends.
questions.explanation: A board game is a game played on a board.

questions.question_text: The artist uses a knife to ______ a beautiful animal from wood.
questions.explanation: Carve means to shape something by cutting wood or another material.

questions.question_text: We use ______ to make boxes and model houses.
questions.explanation: Cardboard is thick paper suitable for making boxes and models.

questions.question_text: My little sister has a pink ______ with tiny rooms and furniture.
questions.explanation: A dollhouse is a small toy house for dolls.

questions.question_text: Making things by hand can develop your ______.
questions.explanation: Creativity is the ability to think of original ideas.

questions.question_text: This unusual collection of coins ______ my grandfather.
questions.explanation: Belongs to is used to show ownership. The subject is singular.

questions.question_text: Which word means 'to gather and keep things as a hobby'?
questions.explanation: Collect means to gather and keep things that you are interested in.

questions.question_text: Which activity involves watching birds in nature?
questions.explanation: Bird-watching means observing birds in their natural environment.

questions.question_text: What is a board game?
options: A game played on a flat board
questions.explanation: A board game is a game played on a board, often with pieces.

options: To cut and shape a material
questions.explanation: Carve means to make something by cutting wood or another material.

questions.question_text: Which material is often used to make boxes?

questions.question_text: A dollhouse is ______.
options: A small toy house for dolls
questions.explanation: A dollhouse is a miniature toy house for dolls.

questions.question_text: Which word means 'the ability to produce original ideas'?
questions.explanation: Creativity means the ability to think of new and original ideas.

questions.question_text: This bicycle belongs ______ my brother.
questions.explanation: The correct phrase is belong to someone.

questions.question_text: Which activity means moving on ice wearing special boots?
questions.explanation: Ice-skating is the activity of moving across ice using ice skates.

questions.question_text: Which word is closest in meaning to 'unusual'?
questions.explanation: Unusual means different from what is normal or common.

questions.question_text: What is a benefit of having a hobby?
options: It can help us relax and learn new skills
It makes us dislike free time
questions.explanation: A benefit is a good or helpful result of an activity.

questions.question_text: Complete the sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets: She is very ______ and always makes interesting things. (CREATE)
questions.explanation: Creative is the adjective form of create. It describes someone who has original ideas.

questions.question_text: My brother enjoys stamp ______. (COLLECT)
questions.explanation: Collecting is the noun or gerund form used to describe the hobby.

questions.question_text: This is an ______ hobby. I have never heard of it before. (USUAL)
questions.explanation: Unusual is formed by adding the prefix un- to usual.

questions.question_text: Reading books has many ______ for children. (BENEFIT)
questions.explanation: Benefits is the plural noun form of benefit.

questions.question_text: My hobby is collecting old coins. It is an interesting ______. (ACT)
questions.explanation: Activity is a noun meaning something that a person does.

questions.question_text: Find and correct the vocabulary mistake: I enjoy bird-looking in the garden.

questions.question_text: Find and correct the vocabulary mistake: My hobby is collecting unusual things. It gives me many benefices.
questions.explanation: The correct plural noun of benefit is benefits.

questions.explanation: Dollhouse is the correct word for a small toy house for dolls.

questions.explanation: Horse riding is the correct expression for riding a horse as an activity.

questions.explanation: The correct phrase to show ownership is belong to.
